title.title: Maddie + Triggs
title.overview: A little girl and her doggy best friend find music and adventure in the sounds of the everyday by really listening to the world around them.

episodes.name: Bubbles
episodes.overview: It's bath time, and Maddie and Triggs embark on a bubble-tastic submarine adventure to the bottom of the ocean in search of Triggs's favourite bath toy, Denis the Ducky.

episodes.name: Raindrops
episodes.overview: When rain threatens to spoil a family camping trip, Maddie and Triggs receive a visit from a happy little raindrop, who soon has the whole gang dancing around the tent.

episodes.name: Bicycle Bell
episodes.overview: A bicycle ride with Dad soon turns into an intergalactic space adventure. Maddie and Triggs imagine themselves as brave explorers, shooting like rockets into the unknown.

episodes.name: Leaves
episodes.overview: While playing in the garden Maddie + Triggs make a new friend named Reginald, and soon discover that crunchy leaves mean much more to this tiny little caterpillar.

episodes.name: Waves
episodes.overview: While playing at the beach, Maddie + Triggs try to save their sandcastle from the incoming tide, in order to provide a fancy home for their magical new friend, Sailor Nancy.

episodes.name: Echoes
episodes.overview: Maddie + Triggs are magically transported to a world of echoes inside the belly of a whale, where they try to help their new friend Harriot rediscover her singing voice.

episodes.name: Birdie
episodes.overview: Triggs is finding it hard to get out of bed, and that pesky birdie outside his window is not helping; but Maddie soon helps him discover what the birdie is really singing about.

episodes.name: Knock Knock
episodes.overview: Maddie + Triggs sing about all the things they love about their favourite travelling Uncle George, as they wait, and wait, and wait... for his latest letter to arrive.

episodes.name: Disco Train
episodes.overview: Maddie longs for some excitement during a very boring visit to her Granny's house, but little does she know that going on a musical adventure with Granny is anything but boring!

episodes.name: The Vet
episodes.overview: During a visit to the vet to get Triggs' sore paw looked at, Maddie makes some new musical friends, who soon reassure her that everything will be okay with her best buddy.

episodes.name: Midnight Feast
episodes.overview: Maddie + Triggs sneak and creak their way past Mum and Dad's bedroom in search of a tasty treat, only to discover they may not be the only ones searching for a midnight feast.

episodes.name: Bonkers Cake
episodes.overview: Maddie + Triggs are baking a cake for Granny, but when the recipe goes missing they are forced to mix it up and add some surprising new ingredients that are quite simply bonkers!

episodes.name: Checkmates
episodes.overview: Maddie is feeling lonely during her first visit to chess club, but before long she meets a new friend who helps her turn that desert island feeling into a tropical paradise.

episodes.name: Pearly Whites
episodes.overview: Dad is struggling to get Maddie to brush her teeth before bed, but a musical visit from her all singing, all dancing pearly whites soon has everyone brushing in perfect harmony.

episodes.name: McGinty’s Farm
episodes.overview: With only minutes to go before the big performance at McGinty's Farm, Maddie has to use all her musical skills to convince Gary the Chicken to perform with the other animals.

episodes.name: Football
episodes.overview: Maddie's neighbour Phillip keeps kicking his football into their garden, much to her frustration. But she soons discovers that Phillip's actions may not be so accidental afterall.

episodes.name: The Fly
episodes.overview: When a rogue fly buzzes in through Maddie's bedroom window, Triggs and Dad attempt to find the most effective way of dealing with this uninvited, buzzy house guest.

episodes.name: The Wind
episodes.overview: Maddie is annoyed when the wind takes her paper bird away, but soon both she and Triggs are blown away on a magical adventure that celebrates all the things the wind can do.

episodes.name: The Bark Park
episodes.overview: Triggs sings about one of his favourite places in the whole world - the dog park, as he and Maddie help a nervous newcomer to find her feet and reclaim her roar.

episodes.name: Triggs' Teddy
episodes.overview: Triggs' favourite teddy is a bit stinky and needs a wash, but poor Triggs is worried and doesn't want to let go. Can Maddie help reassure him that everything will be okay?

episodes.name: Maddie’s Tree
episodes.overview: While helping Nana to prune Mum's tree, Maddie is shocked to learn that this means cutting off all its branches! But as always, Dado has a few crafty surprises up his sleeve.

episodes.name: Microwave
episodes.overview: Maddie + Triggs are intrigued when Mum suggests they use the microwave to cook dinner; can this singing robot microwave really make a healthy meal that's delicious and nutritious?

episodes.name: Xylophone
episodes.overview: While donating some old items to Higgledy Heros charity shop, Maddie has doubts about giving away her old xylophone - can she really let go of her very first musical instrument?!

episodes.name: Bloop Bloop
episodes.overview: There's something fishy about Maddie + Triggs' newest house guest, but they are determined to get to know the new arrival and really figure out what makes him bloop.

episodes.name: No No No
episodes.overview: While helping Mum babysit their neighbour Sally, Maddie + Triggs learn that words can sometimes be confusing, especially if they're coming from the mouth of a mischievous toddler.

episodes.name: The Treasure Indoors
episodes.overview: It's a rainy day and Maddie + Triggs are bored, but when they start to really listen to all the tiny sounds in their house, they soon discover the music of the treasure indoors.

episodes.name: Spoons
episodes.overview: When Maddie + Triggs realise that all the teaspoons have gone missing from the kitchen, Maddie figures out a surprisingly musical way to get them back where they belong.

episodes.name: Muddy Boots
episodes.overview: During a family hiking trip, Dad is adamant that he does not want his pristine hiking shoes getting dirty; can Maddie plot a route and help her buddy avoid getting muddy?

episodes.name: Where In The World
episodes.overview: While helping Mum sort through some of the postcards on the fridge, Maddie + Triggs are transported to magical places as they wonder where oh where can Uncle George be?

episodes.name: Bells
episodes.overview: While out for an afternoon stroll with Granny, Maddie + Triggs discover an old bell tower and are surprised to hear a friendly voice welcoming them inside.

episodes.name: Opposites Attract
episodes.overview: While watching TV, Maddie + Triggs keep annoying each other with their noisy snacking! But luckily Dad is on hand to help them remember the things they like about each other.

episodes.name: Yodel
episodes.overview: While out hillwalking with Mum, Maddie + Triggs meet a new friend who teaches them all about yodelling - an ancient method of communicating over long distances.

episodes.name: Glug Jug
episodes.overview: Maddie accidentally breaks a piece of pottery that Mum made, but instead of doing the right thing and owning up, she starts to worry about how bad everything will now go!

episodes.name: Phillip's Train
episodes.overview: Maddie and Phillip really want their toy train to travel all the way from Phillipsburg to Maddiesville, but getting everyone to agree on exactly how is easier said than done.

episodes.name: Waggy Tail
episodes.overview: Maddie's fun and games are temporarily stopped when Triggs' incredibly waggy tail starts accidentally knocking things over - it's almost like his waggy tail has a life of its own!

episodes.name: Bowling
episodes.overview: It's bowling time! Dad thinks he's a pro - but he's the only one not scoring. Maddie and Triggs sing a doo-wop song to help him focus and find his strike!

episodes.name: Uncle Sitting
episodes.overview: Mum and Dad are heading out which means Maddie + Triggs get to spend the evening with Uncle George, yes - best night ever! Let's just hope they save enough energy for tidying up!

episodes.name: Sports Day
episodes.overview: Due to a classic McGinty mix up, Triggs ends up competing in an obstacle race, but soon discovers that playing to win and playing to have fun are two very different things.

episodes.name: Maddie The Knight
episodes.overview: Maddie + Triggs are putting on an epic stage show in the garden for Mum, but Dad keeps interrupting their performance with his noisy DIY! What is he building in that shed?!

episodes.name: Sunflowers
episodes.overview: Maddie is upset when she discovers that her sunflower has not grown as tall as everyone else's; what could possibly be holding back this little flower from saying yes?

episodes.name: Bats
episodes.overview: Maddie, Triggs and Dad meet a little bat called Brigid who's gotten a bit lost. Can Maddie help this little creature to use her ears and find her way back home?

episodes.name: My Best Friend
episodes.overview: Maddie + Triggs' neighbour Phillip is frustrated that his new pet kitten won't perform any tricks, but Maddie helps him to understand that pets are more than pets.

episodes.name: Dust Bunnies
episodes.overview: Maddie + Triggs learn about taking care of your things, as they try to convince the Dust Bunnies to give them back Triggs' ball, after he accidentally drops it under the couch.

episodes.name: Lights Out
episodes.overview: When the electricity unexpectedly goes out during a sleepover at Nana and Dadó's, Maddie + Triggs are forced to think of other ways to have fun with their family.

episodes.name: Body Beats
episodes.overview: While searching for unique sounds that their bodies can make, Mum introduces Maddie + Triggs to one of the tiniest sounds of all - the sound of their own heart beat.

episodes.name: Dogs With Jobs
episodes.overview: Maddie + Triggs are on their way to the dog park with Mum when they meet a new friend, Lolo. Lolo is a guide dog and explains what it means to be a dog with a job.

episodes.name: Are We There Yet?
episodes.overview: Maddie + Triggs get the giggles as they repeatedly ask Dad, "Are we there yet?", during a family car journey to Nana and Dadó's. If only Dad hadn't tried to take a shortcut!

episodes.name: Ice Cream
episodes.overview: While visiting Mr. Moon's shop with Granny, Maddie finds it difficult to choose what type of ice cream to get - there are just so many different flavours to choose from!

episodes.name: Meditation
episodes.overview: Mum's got a new sound bowl, and Triggs is eager to join her for some meditation. But Maddie soon begins to realise that people have very different ways to feel calm and relaxed.

episodes.name: Veggie Monster
episodes.overview: When Dad discovers that something has been nibbling the veggies in his veggie patch, Maddie + Triggs decide to find out who this veggie monster really is!

episodes.name: Sound Tennis
episodes.overview: Maddie meets a magical new friend called Bella the Ball, and learns how to play "tennis by sound", a sport that requires you to use your ears and really listen!

episodes.name: Goodbye, Not Goodbye
episodes.overview: When Maddie + Triggs realise that it's time for Uncle George to go, they start doing everything they can to stop him from leaving. Is this really goodbye?!?
